{{Quote|I was recently turned down for a Security Director position at this local lab. I don't agree with this decision. I was wondering if I could hire you to make them feel 'insecure' with their current selection.|Borgan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CIP1" />}}
'''Borgan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he applied for a Security Director position at an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="SWG:CIP1" /> a lab specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineer]]ing creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Borgan hired a spacer to take vengeance by attacking the lab and highlight the incompetence of the actual security.<ref name="SWG:CIP1" /><ref name="SWG:CIP2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Corporate Insecurities Part 2|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Borgan appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CIP1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Borgan was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
